quick_skim.title: Overview of the TREC 2025 Million Large Language Models track
quick_skim.abstract: Agentic AI envisions ecosystems of intelligent agents collaboratively solving complex tasks with minimal human intervention. In such ecosystems, each agent possesses specialized expertise, making effective expert selection central to overall system performance. While most current approaches assume a small number of well-documented models, real-world expertise is far more diverse and cannot be adequately captured through static metadata or hand-written descriptions. We anticipate a future with millions of specialized language models (LLMs), each excelling in different domains or problem types. Rather than relying on predefined capability statements, we propose a retrieval-based paradigm in which an assistant agent infers expertise dynamically by examining models' observable behavior. Upon receiving a user query, the assistant ranks candidate LLMs based on demonstrated competence, enabling efficient and adaptive expert selection. The TREC Million LLM Track operationalizes this paradigm by shifting the retrieval target from documents to expert LLMs. Participants are given a discovery set consisting of queries, answers, and log-probabilities from more than one thousand LLMs and are challenged to infer meaningful expertise representations for each model. Given an unseen test query, systems must then rank the LLMs according to their expected performance, providing the first large-scale benchmark for expertise retrieval in agentic AI.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: The TREC 2025 Million LLMs track targets agentic ecosystems of millions of specialized models, where effective expert selection drives system performance. It proposes retrieval-based dynamic expertise inference instead of static metadata or hand-written capability statements.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 智能体生态中每个模型拥有专门能力，专家选择成为整体性能的关键，但现有方法假设模型数量少且依赖静态元数据或人工描述。该赛道提出检索式范式，让助手智能体通过检视模型动态推断其专长，而非依赖预定义的能力声明。组织者据此构建了百万级专业化语言模型的专家选择评测框架。该工作为大规模专家选择与专业化刻画提供了新的基准与思路。
